useWhen: Create and review reference-faithful illustrations with explicit constraints and regression checks.
avoidWhen: Claiming exact visual fidelity, rights clearance or publication approval without review

inputs.references: authorized source images and subject version
inputs.criteria: invariants, intended use and acceptance criteria

outputs.artifact: illustration or editable vector and review record

authority.binding: caller authorization and target runtime policy

validation.runtime: guidance only; target execution not tested

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only; runtime and image-generation tools are not qualified or granted.
